reading: A four-hour shutdown of the UK's air traffic control system caused widespread flight disruption and led to thousands of passengers being affected.
Many people experienced ruined holidays and faced significant financial losses due to unused accommodation and excursions.
Catie and Phil Allen, for instance, lost an estimated £1,300 after their flight to Slovenia never took off.
When a flight is cancelled, airlines must transport customers to their destination as quickly as possible at no extra cost, even if it is with another carrier.
Alternatively, passengers can choose a full refund, which should also be offered for delays longer than five hours.
Extra compensation is usually paid if airlines are at fault, but not in this case, as air traffic issues were beyond their control.
The Allens had booked accommodation and excursions separately, meaning they lost money for these items because their travel insurance policy did not cover air traffic control problems.
Unlike package holidays, which are fully covered if a flight is cancelled, individual bookings often come with different terms.
Some passengers had to sleep on airport floors because airlines could not provide enough accommodation nearby.
Aviation Minister Keir Mather stated that passengers are entitled to care and assistance during delays, but airport capacity was a key lesson to learn.

vocabulary.definition: Happening or existing in many places or among many people.
Situations where you lose money, or the amount of money lost.
A place for someone to stay or live.
Short journeys or trips, especially for pleasure.
Responsible for a mistake or problem.
Unable to be managed or influenced by them.
A plan or course of action, often a formal agreement like an insurance contract.

entries.zh-Hans: 受某事物影响或改变的。

お金を失う状況、または失われた金額。

entries.es: Un lugar para que alguien se quede o viva.
entries.pt-BR: Um lugar para alguém ficar ou morar.

entries.es: Viajes cortos o excursiones, especialmente por placer.
entries.pt-BR: Viagens ou passeios curtos, especialmente por prazer.

entries.ja: おおよそ推測された、または計算された。

entries.pt-BR: Adivinhado ou calculado de forma aproximada.

entries.ja: 間違いや問題に責任があること。

entries.pt-BR: Ser responsável por um erro ou problema.

entries.pt-BR: Que não pode ser gerenciado ou influenciado por eles.
